name: eevee_temporal_material_animation_stability
purpose: Verify that Eevee temporal reprojection keeps a static rendered viewport spatially stable during ordinary material animation and during required Scene Time history invalidation.
passCriteria: The test plays the timeline and captures a static high-contrast emission edge with no animation, with a constant material FCurve, after deleting the FCurve while retaining the empty Action, and with a visually constant Scene Time node path. The ordinary animated states must retain the same bounded temporal edge motion as the control, while the Scene Time state must use a stable deterministic edge because its history is intentionally discarded.
